claims.behavior: Exact staged checkbox, platform-aware defaults and typed legacy migration. Apply refreshes an existing viewer; Cancel and reopen preserve stored choices. Actual pointer events pan using a viewer-owned press anchor and request native cursor warps. Apparent touch is latched only beyond 50 Manhattan pixels, and the optional override then follows the current pointer until the next press. Retired viewer owners cannot pan. Every earlier still-visible viewer also reads saved preferences per input through its independent active lifetime; the latest-viewer slot does not disable it.
limits: Physical cursor warping requires OS/compositor support. Headless native replay proves actual pointer-to-media deltas; pure replay proves exact requested Qt warps, not compositor execution.
This is not a claim for full touch input, other mouse controls, preview canvases or the broader media-viewer family.

referenceRecording.reference: Actual MediaViewerPanel UpdateOptions and displayed JPEG CanvasMediaListBrowser BeginDrag/HandleMouseMoveWithoutEvent/EndDrag. Synthetic pointer coordinates; captured requested cursor warps; real media deltas and saved controls.

claims.validation: fmt/diff/cached warning-aware Slint compilation passed; authored Rust tests pending hosted CI, not executed locally.

ownershipRepair.behavior: Each visible viewer is gated by its own CanvasTracker active/closed lifetime, independent of statistics enablement and the main latest-viewer slot. Older live viewers read saved preferences on actual drag/wheel input; only closed/hidden owners are rejected. Closing an earlier viewer preserves the successor; retained re-shown closed handles stay retired.

hydrus/client/gui/canvas/ClientGUICanvasHoverFrames.py::CanvasHoverFrameTags.wheelEvent reads saved scrolling policy each input (3081)
